summary: Iteration 23 — validated new admin endpoints (DELETE with cascade, bulk-delete, bulk-update), Meta Pixel persistence, tagline/notification migration on /site/settings, plus core admin regression. Backend 15/15 pytest passed. Frontend: red/white theme applied on landing + admin sidebar + login; new admin UI (Meta Pixel card, bulk selection, Bulk Replace modal, cascade toggle) is wired with the expected data-testids. HOWEVER — public Landing page STILL renders MLM/8-Level/downline/'Calculate Earnings' copy sourced from DB-seeded content (sliders, testimonials, FAQs) that was not scrubbed. Also admin Overview page still uses a dark slate-950 hero and non-red (purple/emerald/orange) stat-card accents — the sed color swap did not fully cover those.

Sliders 'Build Your Wealth Network — 8 stages of earnings — Learn the Plan → /business-plan' and 'Become a Top Earner — Calculate Earnings → /calculator' still point to removed routes and display forbidden CTA text.

Seeded FAQ answers include: 'EverGro eMart is a premium e-commerce platform combined with an 8-level MLM income plan' and 'How does the MLM plan work?' from /api/site/faqs.
Dark slate-950 gradient hero (top strip 'REAL-TIME CONTROL ROOM / Admin Overview') is still visible — request said 'NO more dark slate-950 background'.
Icon-tile backgrounds on the four KPI cards still use purple, emerald, and orange gradients (Users / Revenue / Active Members). Task required strictly red+white.
16 DOM elements still carry slate-950/bg-slate-900 classes on rendered admin pages — grep on /app/frontend/src still returns them.

issues: Hero band uses dark slate; conflicts with red/white brief.
Stat cards mix purple/emerald/orange with red — palette not unified.

critical_code_review_comments: admin_bulk_delete_users duplicates the cascade+cleanup logic from admin_delete_user — extract a shared helper `_hard_delete_user_ids(ids)` to avoid drift (currently bulk-delete does NOT delete audit_logs while single-delete DOES).
server.py is now 3427 lines — split into routers.

PublicLayout meta-pixel injection reads from /api/site/settings — but there's no CSP nonce; injecting raw <script> from admin input is an XSS surface for anyone with super_admin token. Consider sanitization or restricting to Pixel ID only in production.

Frontend landing page copy scrub is JSX-only; seeded/managed DB content bypasses it entirely — recommend adding a startup migration + admin content-guard so admins can't reintroduce the forbidden phrases.

rca of the issue: Landing page MLM/downline/'Calculate Earnings' text visible on / is not a JSX regression — Landing.jsx and related components are clean. The strings live in three DB collections (sliders, site.testimonials, site.faqs) that were seeded before the scrub. seed.py only migrates tagline + notification_bar_text — it needs an equivalent block that rewrites/removes forbidden phrases in these collections. Additionally, landing_mid sliders still link to /business-plan and /calculator which App.js redirects to / — so those slider CTAs no longer function meaningfully.
